terminal_name: Malta-Italy Gas Pipeline / Melita TransGas + Delimara Onshore Natural Gas Terminal
issue: Discovery dedup note (no action). The most prominent Malta gas-infrastructure leads are NOT LNG terminals: (1) the Malta-Italy / Melita TransGas Pipeline (159 km subsea gas interconnector, Delimara–Gela Sicily; promoter Melita TransGas Company Limited; Planning Authority full development permit Oct 2021; EU PCI; EIB support reported) is a pipeline, out of scope for the LNG terminals tracker; (2) the 'Delimara Onshore Natural Gas Terminal' (already a GEM record outside the LNG terminals dataset) is a pipeline-fed onshore gas receiving station, NOT an LNG regasification facility — it would receive piped gas from Sicily and is designed to eventually replace the Delimara FSRU. Both are gas/pipeline assets, not new LNG import/export terminals, so neither is a discovery candidate for this tracker.
suggested_action: No LNG-tracker action. Recorded so future discovery sweeps do not re-surface the Malta-Italy pipeline or its onshore receiving station as candidate LNG terminals.
